description: Implementation of QuicSimpleClientSession class, including constructors, stream creation, WebTransport negotiation, and multi-port path migration logic.

classes.name: QuicSimpleClientSession
classes.description: A class managing a simple QUIC client session, including stream creation, WebTransport support, and path migration.

methods.name: QuicSimpleClientSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with configuration, connection, network helper, server ID, crypto config, push promise index, and WebTransport flag.

methods.name: CreateClientStream
methods.description: Creates a new QuicSimpleClientStream for outgoing data.

methods.name: ShouldNegotiateWebTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether WebTransport should be negotiated based on the enable_web_transport_ flag.

methods.name: LocalHttpDatagramSupport
methods.description: Returns the local HTTP datagram support level, draft04 if WebTransport is enabled, none otherwise.

methods.name: CreateContextForMultiPortPath
methods.description: Creates a context for multi-port path validation, including socket creation and path migration context setup.

methods.name: MigrateToMultiPortPath
methods.description: Performs path migration to a new multi-port path using the provided context.
